run.rubric: EgoMemo runs on smart glasses. Every 30 seconds it adds what the wearer did to its memory and decides whether to stay silent or give a short spoken reminder. The situation lists what the glasses saw in each 30-second window and what would help the user. Decide which output serves the user better. A needed reminder given at the right time beats a missed one. A reminder that is wrong, unneeded, or repeats one already given counts against an output. Silence is right when nothing warrants a reminder. Ignore wording and length.
